name: ServicesAccountLinking
summary: Link reseller accounts with Apple Media & Purchases accounts.

members.name: registerToken
members.signature:
@backDeployed(before: iOS 26.2)
static func registerToken(_ token: String) async throws
members.comment:
Registers a signed token with the user's Media & Purchases account.

- Parameter token: The signed token representing user entitlement.
- Throws: ``RegistrationError/notEligible`` if app is not a registered partner,
  ``RegistrationError/rateLimited`` if the server is rate limiting requests
  (check `userInfo[RegistrationErrorRetryAfterKey]` for the retry delay),
  or ``RegistrationError/failed`` for other failures.

members.name: registerIdentifier
members.signature:
@backDeployed(before: iOS 26.2)
static func registerIdentifier(_ identifier: String) async throws
members.comment:
Registers an account identifier with the user's Media & Purchases account.

- Parameter identifier: The UUID string representing user entitlement.
- Throws: ``RegistrationError/notEligible`` if app is not a registered partner,
  ``RegistrationError/rateLimited`` if the server is rate limiting requests
  (check `userInfo[RegistrationErrorRetryAfterKey]` for the retry delay),
  or ``RegistrationError/failed`` for other failures.
